class.name: SoundFontFileReader
class.brief_description: Resource containing raw SoundFont data for use by GDMidiAudioStreamPlayer.
class.description:
SoundFontFileReader is a Resource that holds the raw byte data of a SoundFont (.sf2) file. It is created by the SoundFont importer plugin (import_soundfont_plugin.gd) when importing .sf2 files as .sf2str resources.
The SoundFont data is written to a temporary file on load and passed to FluidSynth's standard file loader, since FluidSynth 2.6+ requires sfload paths that exist on disk.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the raw SoundFont data. Called by the importer during resource import.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the raw SoundFont data as a PackedByteArray.

method.name: get_array_data
method.description: Returns a pointer to the internal memory buffer containing the SoundFont data. Used by the custom sfloader to read SoundFont data directly from memory.

method.name: get_array_size
method.description: Returns the size of the SoundFont data in bytes.

method.name: get_extension
method.description: Returns the file extension for this resource type ("sf2str").

members.member: The raw SoundFont file data as a byte array.
